entries.target: 一把投石索（非固定神器）

entries.source: So much more convenient than a lantern on your waist.
entries.target: 比挂在腰间的提灯方便多了。

entries.source: The pinnacle of steamguns technology. Critical strikes with this gun will feel like a massive explosion of flames! And it actually will be one!
entries.target: 蒸汽枪技术的巅峰之作。用这把枪打出暴击，感觉就像引发了一场猛烈的火焰爆炸！而事实上也确实如此！

entries.source: A special shot moving yourself, or others quickly.
entries.target: 一种特殊弹头，可以将目标生物快速拉向你，或将你快速拉向瞄准的空地。

entries.source: Helps keep your feet on the ground, but still allows mobility.
entries.target: 有助于让你站稳脚跟，同时仍能自如行动。

entries.source: Dismantle any one handed sword/axe/mace, add some amazing steampower to it and make a powerful steamsaw to shred your foes to pieces!
entries.target: 拆解一件单手剑/斧/锤，在上面加入令人惊异的蒸汽能力，让它变成可以把你的敌人撕成碎片的蒸汽链锯！

entries.source: a one handed sword/axe/mace (not unique, without a special damage type)
entries.target: 一把单手剑/斧/锤（非神器，没有特殊伤害类型）

entries.source: A simple contraption consisting of a gem and some metal to enhance your sight, detection and infravision! At tier 4 it even allows you to fight while blinded. #{italic}#Amazing!#{normal}#
entries.target: 这个由宝石和金属组成的简单装置可以增强你的视野、侦测能力和夜视能力！达到材质等级 4 时，它甚至能让你在被致盲时继续战斗。#{italic}#太神奇了！#{normal}#

entries.source: Amaze your friends with this cannister launcher which lets you project deadly poison clouds with but a wave of your hand. #{italic}#Deadly!#{normal}#
entries.target: 用这台毒罐发射装置让朋友们啧啧称奇吧，只需挥一挥手，就能释放致命的毒云。#{italic}#致命！#{normal}#

entries.source: Blight is not dirty to a Tinker, it is useful! By combining blighted materials with a simple mechanical gun, you can fire a low damaging attack that infects foes with terrible diseases.
entries.target: 对工匠来说，枯萎并不肮脏，而是大有用处！将枯萎材料与一把简易机械枪结合，你就能发射一记低伤害的攻击，让敌人感染可怕的疾病。

entries.source: Properly working and tempering a metal can make it harder than normal, and hold a sharper edge.
entries.target: 经过精心的锻造与回火，金属会比平常更加坚硬，刀锋也更加锐利。

entries.source: Want more defense? Wear more armour!
entries.target: 想要更强的防御？再加一层装甲不就行了！

entries.source: Adding a crystal blade to your weapon will make it the flashiest around! (with added light damage and increased critical multiplier)
entries.target: 在你的武器上安装水晶刀刃可以让它闪闪发光！（还能附加光系伤害并增加暴击系数）

entries.source: Boring armour not fancy enough? Bling it up with crystal plating!  Increases all of your base stats.
entries.target: 嫌你的护甲太单调、不够华丽？用水晶镀层给它添点光彩吧！提高你的所有基础属性。

entries.source: From your hands have been wrought incredible works. Your works have been forged in fire, and so have you.
entries.target: 你的双手曾造就无数非凡作品。你的作品在烈火中锻造，你亦如此。

entries.source: Adding metal spikes to anything makes it more dangerous. (and also unwieldy and inconvenient)
entries.target: 在任何东西上加上尖刺都会使它变得更加危险（但穿起来也更加不方便了）

entries.source: In addition to making a weapon look more fancy, it also makes it more deadly against undead and other nasties.
entries.target: 这不仅让武器看起来更加花哨，也能让它更有效地对抗亡灵和其他恐怖的东西。

entries.source: Just what you need to support your back when lifting heavy things; like armour, weapons or Yetis.
entries.target: 当你手拿着武器、重甲或者一只雪人这类重物时候，这个东西能有效分担你身上的重量。

entries.source: Keeping yourself grounded is very important, especially around lightning mages.  Increases lightning and stun resistance.
entries.target: 当你面对雷电法师的时候，保持自己的接地状态是很重要的。提高闪电伤害抗性和震慑抗性。

entries.source:
A powerful healing salve.
To be used with the medical injector implant.
entries.target:
一个强大的治疗药剂。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

entries.source:
A powerful salve that steels your body for a while, letting you survive below 0 life while increasing resistances.
To be used with the medical injector implant.
entries.target:
一种能暂时强化你身体的强力药剂，它可以让你在 0 生命值以下时仍然存活，并提升你的伤害抗性。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

entries.source:
A powerful salve that can clean physical detrimental effects from your body and grant a frost aura (cold, darkness and nature affinity).
To be used with the medical injector implant.
entries.target:
一个可以清除你身上的负面物理效果并获得一个寒霜光环（增加寒冷、暗影和自然伤害亲和）的强大药剂。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

entries.source:
A powerful salve that can clean magical detrimental effects from your body and grant a fiery aura (fire, light and lightning affinity).
To be used with the medical injector implant.
entries.target:
一个可以清除你身上的负面魔法效果并获得一个烈火光环（火焰、光系、闪电伤害亲和）的强大药剂。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

entries.source:
A powerful salve that can clean mental detrimental effects from your body and grant a water aura (blight, mind and acid affinity).
To be used with the medical injector implant.
entries.target:
一个可以清除你身上的负面精神效果并获得一个静水光环（枯萎、精神、酸性伤害亲和）的强大药剂。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

entries.source:
A powerful salve that makes you more resilient to physical, mental and magic effects and grants increased healing.
To be used with the medical injector implant.
entries.target:
一种强大的药剂，能增强你对物理、精神和魔法效果的抵抗能力，并增加你的治疗效果。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

entries.source: Poison grooves can be attached to weapons to apply a stacking poison on attacks.  While this is ideal for stacking simple damage, you can't help but wonder if you could inflict stronger effects with more knowledge..
entries.target: 淬毒凹槽可以安装在武器上，使攻击施加可叠加的中毒效果。虽然它很适合不断叠加简单伤害，但你不禁想，掌握更多知识后是否能施加更强大的效果……

entries.source: Viral grooves allow your weapons to apply an infectious agent on contact, dealing immediate blight damage and reducing their highest stat.  While this strain is effective it lacks the ability to spread or adapt to its hosts weaknesses.  Perhaps there are better methods to be found.
entries.target: 病毒之槽可以让你的武器攻击附带病毒效果，立即造成枯萎伤害并降低他们最高的数值。尽管这个方法行之有效，但它缺乏传播和适应宿主的弱点的能力。或许还有更好的方法…

entries.source: Apply your extensive therapeutics knowledge to try and defeat death itself!
entries.target: 应用你广泛的医疗知识，击败死亡本身！

entries.source: Not only does it help seal wounds, protecting you from bleeding and enhancing your healing, it also protects from armour chafe!
entries.target: 它不仅能封住伤口、防止流血并增强治疗效果，还能防止盔甲擦伤皮肤！

entries.source: Helps keep your airway open and lets you hold your breath longer.
entries.target: 有助于保持呼吸道畅通，并让你屏息更久。

entries.source: Where you walk nature grows! Well moss. Sticky moss.
entries.target: 你走到哪里，哪里就一片绿荫…虽然那是粘粘的苔藓。

entries.source: This mesh of fungal threads absorbs nutrients for salves to provide you with added healing!
entries.target: 这层真菌丝网能为药剂吸收养分，从而为你提供额外治疗！
